$comment: Hand-edited (docs/SCHEMA.md). The heritage railways that carry the public today; GTFS doesn't cover them. Research: docs/research/sources-2c/heritage.md.

lines.name: Niles Canyon Railway, Niles to Sunol
lines.summary: Excursion trains behind diesel and steam through Niles Canyon between Sunol and Niles, on select weekends, run by volunteers of the Pacific Locomotive Association.

sources.note: Track of the Pacific Locomotive Association, on a right of way the county owns; "A few tourist/excursion trains per week" (2010).
The first train ran into Sunol on May 21, 1988; Niles to Sunol, 7 miles.

lines.notes: Its first train ran on May 21, 1988 (Classic Trains); left null here because today's network takes its dates from official sources only. Its public trains board at Sunol in 2026, by its own schedule (ncry.org, seen only through a search).

lines.name: Napa Valley Wine Train, Napa to St. Helena
lines.summary: Dining trains from the McKinstry St station in Napa up the valley to St. Helena and back, a 36-mile round trip on the Southern Pacific's old Napa Valley branch.

sources.note: "The NVRR operates four passenger trains per day" through the Soscol Ave crossing (2021).
The Public Utilities Commission's approval of August 23, 1989; service to begin as early as September 16.

lines.notes: Railfan & Railroad gives the Public Utilities Commission's approval of August 23, 1989 and a start as early as September 16, 1989; left null here because today's network takes its dates from official sources only, and the Commission's 1989 decision isn't online. Wine Industry Advisor announced a ride for March 24, 2026 (February 24, 2026, seen only through a search).

lines.name: Western Railway Museum, Rio Vista Junction
lines.summary: Interurban and streetcar rides at the Western Railway Museum, south from Rio Vista Junction over the Sacramento Northern's old main line, on weekends.

sources.note: Operating 8 miles of the former Sacramento Northern main line by 1989.

lines.notes: When rides on the Sacramento Northern's main line began isn't sourced (by 1989, Railfan & Railroad). Its current schedule couldn't be confirmed here: wrm.org was unreachable, and search found no 2026 listing.
